blocks: It contains no perfect fifth, no leading tone and no minor or major triad; every triad built from it is augmented. No note can function as a tonic without help from outside the scale.
The French augmented sixth chord (A♭ C D F♯ in C) is a four-note subset of the scale, a pivot between functional and whole-tone harmony.
